requirements.title: Supported input surface
requirements.text: The translator SHALL accept only the documented Pod subset and SHALL refuse every other field by field path.

requirements.title: Translation totality
requirements.text: translate() SHALL either return schema-valid output or raise TranslationError, and SHALL NOT mutate its input.

requirements.title: Resource fidelity
requirements.text: Requests and limits SHALL be preserved exactly in canonical requests/limits maps.

requirements.title: Quantity grammar
requirements.text: Quantity parsing SHALL reject negative, malformed, non-finite and >2^63-1 values.

requirements.title: Privileged refusal
requirements.text: Privileged containers, hostPath, hostNetwork and hostPID SHALL be refused before any side effect.

requirements.title: CRD contract
requirements.text: The controller SHALL reconcile WasmWorkload inv67.linearfinance.org/v1alpha1 with a status subresource and SHALL NOT prune unknown template fields.

requirements.title: End-to-end lifecycle
requirements.text: A representative workload SHALL complete create, identity, authz, compat, translate, place, status and delete without manual repair.

requirements.title: Idempotent reconcile
requirements.text: Repeated reconciles and resyncs SHALL NOT launch a workload more than once per attempt.

requirements.title: Generation tracking
requirements.text: A new spec generation SHALL produce a new attempt id and replace the prior placement; status SHALL carry observedGeneration.

requirements.title: Lifecycle legality
requirements.text: Every lifecycle transition SHALL be classified legal or illegal and illegal transitions SHALL be rejected.

requirements.title: Error taxonomy
requirements.text: Every refusal SHALL carry a registered stable code, reason and retryable flag.

requirements.title: Partial success
requirements.text: Multi-unit workloads SHALL aggregate unit state deterministically (any Failed => Failed).

requirements.title: Deletion safety
requirements.text: Deletion SHALL retain the finalizer until the downstream cancel succeeds.

requirements.title: Identity
requirements.text: Application identity SHALL include the object uid and SHALL fail closed for unbound namespaces.

requirements.title: Least privilege
requirements.text: The controller SHALL hold no delete/create on WasmWorkloads, no access to Secrets or Pods, and no wildcards.

requirements.title: Authentication
requirements.text: Unauthenticated, expired, malformed or mis-signed credentials SHALL be refused.

requirements.title: Tenancy
requirements.text: Workloads outside bound namespaces or the configured watch scope SHALL be refused.

requirements.title: Artifact trust
requirements.text: Images SHALL come from an allowed registry, be digest-pinned and carry a verifiable attestation when required; with no verifier admission SHALL fail closed.

requirements.title: Certification
requirements.text: Workloads using features not certified by GAP-15 SHALL be refused.

requirements.title: Compatibility matrix
requirements.text: Peers outside the supported version matrix SHALL be refused at startup.

requirements.title: Constraint precedence
requirements.text: Conflicting constraints SHALL resolve by the documented precedence and unknown constraints SHALL deny.

requirements.title: Secrets
requirements.text: Secrets SHALL be referenced by secretRef only, never logged, and missing or world-readable secrets SHALL fail closed.

requirements.title: Config validation
requirements.text: Configuration SHALL be schema-validated and unknown keys refused.

requirements.title: Config activation
requirements.text: Activation SHALL be atomic with a provenance record and one-step rollback.

requirements.title: Bootstrap
requirements.text: Startup SHALL run an ordered deterministic check list and abort on the first failure.

requirements.title: Audit trail
requirements.text: Security-relevant actions SHALL be recorded in a hash chain that detects edit, reorder, deletion and tail truncation.

requirements.title: Bounded retry
requirements.text: Retries SHALL use bounded full-jitter backoff and a shared retry budget.

requirements.title: Admission/shedding
requirements.text: Per-tenant and global in-flight ceilings and rate limits SHALL be enforced; unknown tenants get the default quota.

requirements.title: Circuit breaking
requirements.text: Downstream failures SHALL open a circuit and status SHALL report Degraded; recovery SHALL not duplicate launches.

requirements.title: Leader election
requirements.text: Exactly one controller SHALL act; a stale leader's writes SHALL be rejected by fencing.

requirements.title: Crash consistency
requirements.text: Side effects SHALL be journalled before execution and replayed with the original idempotency key after restart.

requirements.title: Emergency controls
requirements.text: Freeze SHALL block launches but not deletion; quarantine SHALL be terminal until released.

requirements.title: Disconnected operation
requirements.text: Loss of the API server SHALL NOT tear down running workloads and SHALL converge on reconnect.

requirements.title: Stale observation
requirements.text: Missing runtime observations beyond staleObservationSec SHALL project Unknown.

requirements.title: Watch expiry
requirements.text: A 410 Gone watch SHALL trigger a relist without losing objects.

requirements.title: Health endpoints
requirements.text: /healthz, /readyz, /version, /configz and /metrics SHALL reflect loop progress and dependency health.

requirements.title: Metrics
requirements.text: Metrics SHALL be Prometheus-formatted with bounded label cardinality.

requirements.title: Logs
requirements.text: Logs SHALL be structured JSON with secret-like keys redacted.

requirements.title: Tracing
requirements.text: Spans SHALL propagate W3C traceparent context.

requirements.title: Explain view
requirements.text: The explain view SHALL summarize state and redact secret-like values.

requirements.title: Conditions
requirements.text: Condition lastTransitionTime SHALL change only when status flips; messages SHALL be bounded.

requirements.title: Wire contracts
requirements.text: Placement envelopes and conditions emitted at runtime SHALL conform to their published schemas.

requirements.title: Performance SLO
requirements.text: Translation p99 SHALL be under 5 ms on the reference benchmark, with regression gating against a baseline.

requirements.title: Deployment hardening
requirements.text: The controller Deployment SHALL run non-root, read-only root FS, no privilege escalation, all capabilities dropped, digest-pinned image.

requirements.title: Release integrity
requirements.text: Every shipped file SHALL be listed with SHA-256 in a manifest that fails on unexpected, missing or altered files.

requirements.title: Checklist gate
requirements.text: The executable gate SHALL evaluate all 68 components and SHALL NOT report PASS without independent evidence.
